content:
Judy teaches 5 classes each weekday (Monday through Friday), which is 5 days × 5 classes = 25 classes. On Saturday, she teaches 8 classes. Total classes per week = 25 + 8 = 33 classes.

Each class has 15 students, so total student attendances = 33 × 15 = 495.

She charges $15.00 per student, so total money = 495 × $15 = $7,425.

Answer: $7,425
